BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

2. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

5. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.

6. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

8. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

11. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.

12. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

14. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.

15. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

16. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
